app.headline: Laboratory management you can trust, built for Egypt
app.lede: Orders, barcode accession, chain of custody, QC and authorized release for independent labs and small chains. In discovery with labs now; pilot planned for month 19.
caps: Bilingual test catalogue, walk-in, clinic and Kiorex orders, two-identifier patient check, home collection.
Unique accession numbers, barcode labels, aliquots and an append-only chain of custody.
Analyzer interfaces, Levey-Jennings charts and Westgard rules that block release on violation.
Technical and medical validation, corrected report versions, release only through consented channels.
Alert the ordering clinician and lab director; escalate if not acknowledged in time.
Price lists, packages, payer contracts, invoices and turnaround dashboards.
app.safety: QC blocks, authorized release, critical-value escalation, unique accession and chain of custody are on in every edition and cannot be switched off.
app.footer: Kiorly by Kiorex. Skeleton build: no patient or result data is processed.
